notes.title: Ghosts 'n Goblins Resurrection Original Soundtrack Now Available!
notes.notes:
The beats 'n bass of the [i]Ghosts 'n Goblins Resurrection Original Soundtrack[/i] is available now on Steam!

The soundtrack comes with MP3 (V0 bitrate), FLAC (16-bit), and AAC (Variable bitrate) music files. Ownership of the base [i]Ghosts 'n Goblins Resurrection[/i] game is not required to purchase this soundtrack.

Get over to our curated list of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/capcom/list/37726/]Capcom Original Soundtracks on Steam[/url] and buy some of your favorite soundtracks – and find some new favorites while you’re there!
